evidence: The film thickness and refractive index were measured by ellipsometry which was calibrated by high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM). The Pb- and Ti-concentrations in the films were measured by X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy (XRF, Spectrace Co., model QuanX). Composition analysis in the depth direction was performed by Au-ger electron spectroscopy (AES, Perkin-Elmer 660). X-ray diffraction (XRD) in θ-2θ mode was used to investigate the crystal structure of the film. The film surface morphology was investigated by field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM) and atomic force microscopy (AFM, JEOL, JSPM-5200). The local leakage current was investigated by conducting AFM (CAFM, JEOL, JSPM5200) using an Ir/Au coated Si tip. The composition uniformity along the depth direction was checked by AES. The surface morphology and local electrical conduction properties of the PTO film after FFA at 600°C was investigated by SEM and LCAFM.
